_doc: Which sound each thing the battle does plays (src/Core/Sim/BattleSounds.cs, read by src/Game/View/BattleAudio.cs; owner, 2026-11-10: "Implement sound fx in the game"; openspec/changes/sound-effects design section 3). Every name is a cue of data/audio/cues.json. shots: a shot of each kind as it leaves its mount, placed at the mount; a kind not listed is silent (flares, decoys, a boarding party's shoot). intercept: point defence's beam at a missile or fighter. Hits (Battle.Hits), placed at the ship hit: shield_hit when the shield took it all, hull_hit when the hull took damage, torpedo_hit for a torpedo or a forge slug on the hull, destroyed as a ship goes. lightning: an ion storm's strike on a ship, placed. Unplaced, the commanded ship's own: lock when a new target is locked, hull_critical once as its hull falls below hull_critical_frac (again after it climbs back over), pause_on and pause_off with the pause key. repeat_s: a cue does not play again within this many battle seconds of itself (a volley of eight lances is one sound, not eight on top of each other).
